description: This file contains the ProfilesController class which handles HTTP requests related to user profiles in an ASP.NET Core application. It uses MediatR to handle query requests for profile details.

classes.name: ProfilesController
classes.description: Controller responsible for profile-related API endpoints, specifically retrieving profile details based on username.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to fetch profile details for a given username using MediatR to send the query.
